answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a sunk 5 POA fee that burns like an ember, never refunded. Each applicant registers as one vertex in a public referral graph, and every registration is carved in marble on a public ledger so duplicates are visible. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 x 5 = 500 POA, all destroyed, while an honest agent pays once and earns it back from 20 epochs of mining rewards. Fakes cost more than they can ever earn.
